facts.en: Completed a media administration diploma at Fictional Pearlwick College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构珠芯学院完成媒体行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid caption production assistant at Fictional Cloverframe Studio from 2023-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2026-08 在虚构苜蓿帧工作室任有薪字幕制作助理。

facts.en: Maintained a delivery tracker for prerecorded training videos using approved production schedules.
facts.zh: 依据获批制作排期维护预录培训视频交付跟踪表。

facts.en: Checked supplied English captions against the English audio for spelling, omitted words and speaker-label consistency.
facts.zh: 对照英语音频检查所提供的英语字幕，核对拼写、漏词及说话人标签一致性。

facts.en: Flagged uncertain audio passages for the editor rather than guessing the words.
facts.zh: 将不确定的音频片段标记给编辑，而非猜测文字。

facts.en: Checked caption timecodes against the studio’s supplied timing checklist.
facts.zh: 依据工作室提供的时间核对表检查字幕时间码。

facts.en: Applied the approved file-naming convention and kept superseded deliveries in a labeled archive.
facts.zh: 应用获批文件命名规则，并将已被替代的交付文件存入有标记的归档。

facts.en: Recorded revision requests, assigned due dates from the producer’s schedule and sent status updates.
facts.zh: 记录修订请求，依据制作人的排期分配截止日期，并发送状态更新。

facts.en: Created a caption-delivery checklist in 2024-09 with the studio editor.
facts.zh: 2024-09 与工作室编辑共同制作字幕交付核对表。

facts.en: Personally drafted the filename and version fields; the editor defined the language-review criteria.
facts.zh: 个人起草文件名及版本字段；语言审核标准由编辑制定。

facts.en: During a 2025-02 internal check, all 18 sampled delivery folders contained the required caption file and revision log.
facts.zh: 2025-02 内部检查中，抽样的全部 18 个交付文件夹均包含所需字幕文件及修订日志。

facts.en: The folder check measured document presence, not caption accuracy, audience comprehension or revenue.
facts.zh: 文件夹检查衡量文件是否存在，而非字幕准确性、观众理解程度或收入。

facts.en: Uses caption-editor playback controls, spreadsheet filters and shared-folder permissions assigned by the producer.
facts.zh: 使用字幕编辑器播放控件、电子表格筛选及制作人分配的共享文件夹权限。

facts.en: Prepared editor handover notes identifying unresolved passages and the current approved version.
facts.zh: 准备编辑交接备注，列明未解决片段及当前获批版本。

facts.en: The producer approved final publication; the candidate prepared delivery packages after that approval.
facts.zh: 制作人批准最终发布；候选人在批准后准备交付包。

facts.en: Completed an internal caption-style orientation in 2023-01.
facts.zh: 2023-01 完成内部字幕风格入门培训。

facts.en: Captioned a personal 4-minute craft demonstration in 2022 using the candidate’s own narration.
facts.zh: 2022 年为个人 4 分钟手工演示制作字幕，使用候选人本人的旁白。

facts.en: Volunteered to label screening materials at Fictional Dawnpaper Film Club in 2021-10.
facts.zh: 2021-10 在虚构晨纸电影社志愿标记放映材料。

facts.en: Enjoys recording miniature stop-motion scenes as a hobby.
facts.zh: 爱好拍摄微型定格动画场景。

facts.en: The paid role covered English-language prerecorded material, not live captioning or translation.
facts.zh: 该有薪岗位涵盖英语预录材料，不涉及实时字幕或翻译。
